newsitem.title: USA: CBOT raises wheat margins, expands daily limits.
newsitem.headline: CBOT raises wheat margins, expands daily limits.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade wheat futures will trade with expanded margin requirements and on expanded daily limits following Monday's 20-cent limit gains, the exchange said.
The expanded limits for wheat will be 30 cents per bushel, beginning with the open outcry session on Tuesday, April 15.
Project A will trade with expanded limits and margins beginning with the Tuesday night session, CBOT said.
The initial margin requirement for wheat was raised to $1,418 per contract with maintenance and hedge margins at $1,050 per contract.
